question: Can naturally formed connected seven-native-edge 3x3 barriers with native unbonded mobile resident persist >=30 consecutive observed ticks in at least two distinct NEW seeds under unchanged M6 dynamics?

sample.start: World.create, original M6 config at two M6.4 densities, no seeded bonds/templates

definitions.new_seed_unit: A distinct numeric seed is the conservative independent unit across densities; baseline/enriched same seed must not count twice toward primary replication gate.
definitions.valid_precursor: Use unchanged M6.12 seven-native-edge material-path observer: eight particles form exact 3x3 perimeter; seven native edges connect them, no off-component bonds, native mobile grade-zero resident at center.
definitions.continuous_barrier: Same seven ORIGINAL bonds intact without even transient breaks, same eight material IDs fixed at perimeter positions, and same native mobile center resident ID. Eighth bond may close or reopen.
definitions.observed_duration: Count from first observed precursor tick through last tick of intact seven original edges. End at first break even if same-tick reformation; 600-tick right-censored episodes keep observed lower bound.
definitions.canonical_event: Use first episode of a given source material ID set per world as strict sensitivity check. Repeated closure episodes still reported separately.
definitions.status: Persistence is geometric confinement by static occupied nearest-neighbor cells; not cell life, biological membrane, metabolism, Darwinian evolution or self replication.

preregistered_primary.success: At least TWO DISTINCT NEW numeric seeds (regardless of density pairing) contain a native mobile resident confined by an intact original seven-edge perimeter for >=30 observed ticks. Count both ended and right-censored >=30, but label censored cases as lower bounds.
preregistered_primary.one: Exactly one distinct seed qualifies => single_not_independently_replicated
preregistered_primary.first_material_only_check: Apply same >=30 criterion to first episode per material ID set; include sensitivity and disagreements.
preregistered_primary.conservative_pairing: Never count baseline and enriched worlds at the same numeric seed as two independent replications.

secondary.count: All valid seven-edge episodes; number of unique material sets; unbonded mobile resident episodes; source worlds; distinct seeds; first-of-material subset; right-censoring.
secondary.rarity: Point estimate and Wilson interval for proportion of 400 numeric seeds with >=30 observations, and density-specific 400-world proportions; no p-value from dependent episode/tick data.
secondary.eighth_edge: Report formation of eighth bond as a separate event, NOT origin of confinement.
secondary.world_rates: Also report rates among the 800 world configurations but mark paired-by-seed correlation.
secondary.historical: M6.11 and M6.12 evidence is exploratory motivation, NEVER included in confirmatory M6.13 numerator/denominator.

integrity.no_observer_replays: For each world with >=30-tick resident confinement, and fixed baseline/enriched seed12001, recreate without observer and require identical final full hash/RNG/draws/energy/physical counters.
